# Francesco Memoli (akiidjk)

> Portfolio of Francesco Memoli, known online as akiidjk — first-year Computer Science student at UNISA, CTF player specializing in web exploitation, and builder interested in microservices, DevOps, and distributed systems architecture. Co-founder of the CTF team ByteTheCookies, based in Salerno, Italy.
